The ship is coming in to dock with the defense platform right now.|[[General/Legends|General]] [[Afren Hul]] and his [[Aide/Legends|aide]]|<ref name="OE" />}}
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], the [[Khuiumin Survivors]] '''ambushed''' the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Brazen]]'' near the [[Degan Gas Clouds]].<ref name="OE" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|As you probably know by now, the ''Brazen'' was heavily damaged in an attack by the Khuiumin Survivors pirate gang. I need you to finish the job. You must destroy the ''Brazen''.|[[Dnalla]]|<ref name="OE" />}}
[[File:Brazen.jpg|thumb|left|225px|The ''Brazen'' after the ambush]]
The [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Brazen]]'' managed to escape the battle and went to [[Derilyn]] to receive temporary repairs on its [[Engine/Legends|engines]] at the facilities of the [[Derilyn Space Defense Platform]]. The plan was to perform limited repairs on the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] so that it would be able to reach a fully-equipped [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]], most probably a [[Deepdock/Legends|deepdock]] facility located towards the [[Metharian Nebula/Legends|Metharian Nebula]]. However, the ''Brazen'' was [[Battle of Derilyn|destroyed]] by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Agent/Legends|agents]] who infiltrated the Derilyn Space Defense Platform.<ref name="OE" />
